paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Planning Analyst role on Eataly's corporate FP&A team in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I like that this role sits close to the stores, looking at inventory, COGS, labor and margins and using that to help each location run more profitably.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and streamlined the order-to-cash process with automation, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%.
That maps to the P&L, margin and sales analysis your team does, and to the push for more automation in reporting. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
